entities.summary: Arabella Latham, known professionally as Baby Queen, is a South African singer based in London. Born and raised in Durban, South Africa, she moved to London at 18 to pursue a career in music and signed a recording contract with Polydor Records in 2020. Baby Queen was a composers & musicians from Durban (b. 1997-08-19, Durban). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
